quote: What makes the quiet hours so heavy is that, you carry the ghost of every choice. We hold onto words that were never meant to stay. We punish ourselves for paths we did not walk. Every closed door leaves a shadow on the floor. In the end, peace comes only when you finally stop fighting the dark.
